# Andrei Sherikhov (Sherikxd)

> 18-year-old self-taught developer from Cali, Colombia, coding since he was 7.
> Web apps, AI tools and Ethereum infrastructure. 31 public repos, 38 GitHub
> followers. 2nd place at the EAG Global Buildathon (Cali, sep 2026).
> Open to new projects — sherikdev@gmail.com

Sherikxd builds things that keep working when the network, the database or a
service goes down: offline-first apps, fallback chains, realtime pipelines.

## Projects

- [AyudaEnCali](https://github.com/Sherikxd/AyudaEnCali): community emergency platform for Cali — interactive map, needs board and an AI assistant (CaliSolidaria IA) that works even when Supabase or Gemini is down. React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Leaflet, Supabase, Clerk, Vercel.
- [NatureIntelligence / deteccion-incendio-hackathon](https://github.com/Sherikxd/deteccion-incendio-hackathon): forest fire detection for Cali and Valle del Cauca — NASA FIRMS/VIIRS + NOAA GOES-16 telemetry, IoT stations, thermal cameras, an AI false-positive filter, SSE/websocket alerts and a Rothermel spread simulator. Built in 48 hours.
- [Áureo](https://github.com/Sherikxd/aureo): open-source Ethereum middleware that watches corporate transfers registered on-chain and scores them live with deterministic speed + volume rules, returning a risk verdict (high/medium/low) over CLI, API and WebSocket with auditable evidence. Solidity, Hardhat, Node, Ethers. 2nd place, EAG Global Buildathon.
